ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across visible surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones on both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a thick border along the trailing edge and outer margin of the left lobe, with irregular mottled extensions projecting toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the continuous linear boundary of the left lobe's trailing edge; right lobe edge is obscured by water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve observed on the leading margin of the left lobe, tapering to a sharp distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly 12-15 white circular pixel groups localized on the black distal margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct dark linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the lower-central white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white circular scarring on the distal margins of the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent isolated black pixel splotch located on the inner-upper quadrant of the left lobe's white field, disconnected from the marginal pigmentation.
